items.title: Embassy of India — identification of mortal remains (1 Sep 2026)
items.summary: Embassy of India, Kathmandu (1 Sep 2026): guidance on identification and handover of mortal remains after the Nepal flash floods. Relatives may check photos and descriptions on the Nepal Police UDB disaster portal (udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/disaster). For DNA matching of interred remains, first-degree relatives can email profiles to dnacodis@nepalpolice.gov.np and CC eoikathmandufloodsupport@gmail.com; relatives in Nepal may give blood samples to authorities. Nepal Police helpline: +977-9841616095. Embassy helplines (WhatsApp): +977-9851316807, +977-9709107500, +977-9810326117. Handover follows a nine-step Nepal government process including documentation, post-mortem, identification, DNA/fingerprint collection, and embassy coordination.

items.title: Nepal Police — DNA profiling for unidentified remains
items.summary: Nepal Police asks relatives of people missing after the Rasuwa / Bhote Koshi floods to help identify recovered bodies through DNA. In Nepal: first-degree relatives (father, mother, son or daughter) can give a fresh blood sample plus two passport-size photos at Nepal Police Hospital Pathology Lab, Maharajgunj, or the nearest District Police Office. Abroad: get DNA profiling at an authorised forensic lab and email the report to dnacodis@nepalpolice.gov.np with the missing person’s name, nationality, ID/passport details, place/date of disappearance if known, and relationship. Contact: Police Inspector Sambhu Bahadur KC, +977-9841616095. Always follow Nepal Police instructions on the original post.
items.citation: Nepal Police HQ — Information on DNA Profiling for unidentified Dead Bodies (31 Aug)

items.title: NDRRMA situation update — 9:00 a.m., 31 August 2026
items.summary: NDRRMA 9:00 a.m. update (31 Aug): 903 confirmed dead; 4,247 missing; 10,451 rescued so far. Fatalities reported across districts including Chitwan (272), Nawalparasi East (207), Nawalparasi West (151), Nuwakot (95), Gorkha (62), Dhading (55), Tanahun (37), Rasuwa (24). Missing includes large groups in Nuwakot and Rasuwa, hydropower workers, security/government personnel, and foreign nationals. 20,811 security personnel deployed; helicopter operations continuing. Unidentified remains at 21 district hospitals — confirm all figures on ndrrma.gov.np and Nepal Police portals.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — 9:00 a.m. search/rescue/relief update (31 Aug)

items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
